packageRules.description: Harness: everything that isn't a candidate, Node in .node-version included, in one PR a month, merged by hand. Each of these changes the rig.

Candidates: a release line moves to its newest stable release once that release is 7 days old, and the PR merges itself when CI passes. The fleet measures it at its next six-hourly check, lands the run, and updates the site.
ESLint 9 is the previous line, measured while ESLint patches it: it never leaves 9.x.
A new major is a new release line, added by hand as a new alias. The dashboard lists it; approving it there would move the existing line instead, so don't.
